name: Date Me!
source:
Moving into a new apartment building is great... Having skeleton monsters as your neighbors is even better. You're that one special person that is on everyone's radar. You'll decide who you want to get to know and be close with. If romance is in the air, well you know what to do.

[From [url=https://datemevn.itch.io/date-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搬进新的公寓楼真是太棒了……有骷髅怪物做邻居就更好了。你是每个人都关注的特别的人。你将决定你想认识谁并与谁保持亲密关系。如果空气中弥漫着浪漫的气息，那么你知道该怎么做。

[来自[url=https://datemevn.itch.io/date-me]Itch.io[/url]]
